title: Bird-in-Hand Stage

services.name: RV/Tent sites
services.desc: Tent and pop-up sites, full-hookup RV and big-rig sites, and cozy log cabins spread across 18 acres of Lancaster County countryside, for families, couples, and road-trippers looking to unplug and reconnect. From clean, modern sites to spacious pull-throughs built for big rigs, our RV sites come with water, sewer, 30- or 50-amp electric and cable TV. Choose an open or tree-shaded spot with easy access to the pool, camp store and all our amenities. Pitch a tent or set up your pop-up on a scenic, grassy site. Go primitive with no hookups for a true getaway, or choose a site with water and 30-amp electric, some with cable TV. Many sites sit around a shady grove overlooking Amish farmland.
